silence.anchor: Every check relies only on behaviour that the manual describes

restrictions.statement: Use only the Python standard library, without loading native code (through `ctypes`, for example), and do not start other programs
restrictions.how: every graded run goes through tests/guard.py, which ends the run on a process start, on native code loaded through ctypes, and on an import from outside the standard library and the delivered files, counting an installed package under the standard-library directory as outside it; six probe programs check the launcher. The static read of the delivered package was removed in revision-v5: the instruction says the three rules are checked while the program runs, and a static rejection of a data file by its first bytes failed a contract-legal delivery (v5 finding 19)

removed_obligations.reason: not core: the task is a byte-exact ed, the verifier delivers no signal, and grading a timed interrupt would make the result depend on when it arrives

former_anchor.anchor: with these exceptions: shell commands, the options `-G` and `-v`, and the commands `h` and `H`

removed_obligations.note: the instruction now lists signals among the parts of the manual the program need not cover

documented_exceptions.rule: Where GNU ed 1.19 departs from its manual, the program decides
